title: School Notebooks 5-pack

drivers.name: TikTok trend
drivers.evidence: Product trending on TikTok; no prior data, but could drive trial. Noise-adjusted uplift from past promotions is only x1.16. One-time social spike, untested.

drivers.name: Price increase
drivers.evidence: Price up 2.3% vs regular. Recent weeks at $9.03 saw sales 10–16 units (baseline 7.6), averaging x1.31 vs baseline. But 2026-10-05: 7 units, x0.92. Slight dampening effect likely.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 7.6. No events or promotions are scheduled. The price increased 2.3% to $9.03, which may dampen demand. However, the product is trending on TikTok—unverified but potentially impactful. Past promotions had mixed results: a 30% off promo lifted sales 2.86x, but recent non-promo weeks at $9.03 (e.g., 2026-09-28: 10 units, x1.31; 2026-10-05: 7 units, x0.92) show no sustained lift. The noise-adjusted effect of past promotions is only x1.16. The TikTok trend is a single, unverified driver. Evidence is thin. Adjust cautiously: shrink toward 1.0. The baseline already reflects seasonal ramp-up and recent trends. No post-promo dip observed. Final adjustment: minimal lift, with high uncertainty.

TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-06 (8 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 9.03 (+2.3% vs regular price 8.83)
  planner notes: Product is trending on TikTok

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 7.6 | 5%-95%: 0.0 - 42.1 | 10%-90%: 0.0 - 26.8

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-64% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
